sents.t: Central Station, one of the busiest stations in the city, will be renovated starting in January.
The project will add new escalators, brighter lighting, and a larger waiting area.
Trains will continue to run during the work, but some entrances will be closed temporarily.
City officials say the work will take about eighteen months.
Many passengers welcomed the news, especially those who have been lost in the station's maze of tunnels for years.
